entries.name: Margin lending
entries.definition: Lending money to investors so they can buy securities, with the securities held as collateral.

entries.name: Marine navigation
entries.definition: Finding a vessel's position and plotting and following its course at sea.

entries.name: Marine radar
entries.definition: Radar equipment used on ships to detect other vessels, land and hazards.

entries.name: Marionette.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript library built on Backbone.js that adds application structure, composite views and event handling for single-page apps.

entries.name: Maritime law enforcement
entries.definition: Enforcing laws and regulations at sea and in ports, for example by patrolling, boarding vessels and stopping smuggling or illegal fishing.

entries.name: Market capitalization
entries.definition: The total market value of a company's shares, found by multiplying the share price by the number of shares outstanding.

entries.name: Market depth
entries.definition: A measure of how many buy and sell orders sit at different prices, showing how large a trade a market can absorb without the price moving much.

entries.name: Marketing management
entries.definition: Planning, coordinating and overseeing an organisation's marketing work, from research and strategy to campaigns and results.

entries.name: Marketing strategy
entries.definition: Deciding which customers, offers and channels a business will focus on to meet its marketing goals.

entries.name: Masonry
entries.definition: The craft of building walls and structures by laying bricks, stone or concrete blocks with mortar.

entries.name: Mass media
entries.definition: The study of the channels, such as press, broadcasting and online platforms, that reach large audiences.

entries.name: Massage
entries.definition: Working the muscles and soft tissue of the body by hand to ease tension and pain or to help a person relax.

entries.name: Master production records
entries.definition: Controlled documents that set out the materials, steps and checks for making a product batch in regulated manufacturing.

entries.name: Material flow
entries.definition: How raw materials, parts and finished goods move through a plant or supply chain, and how that movement is planned and tracked.

entries.name: Materials testing
entries.definition: Measuring the strength, hardness and other physical or chemical properties of materials to check they meet a specification.

entries.name: Mathematica
entries.definition: Wolfram's software system for symbolic and numerical computation, visualisation and programming.

entries.name: Mathematics
entries.definition: The study of numbers, quantities, shapes and patterns, and of the logical reasoning used to prove facts about them.

entries.name: Matplotlib
entries.definition: A Python library for drawing static, animated and interactive plots and charts.

entries.name: McAfee Personal Firewall Plus
entries.definition: A personal firewall program from McAfee that filters network traffic on a Windows computer.

entries.name: MCollective
entries.definition: An orchestration framework, from Puppet Labs, for running commands in parallel across many servers through a messaging middleware.

entries.name: Meal planning and preparation
entries.definition: Deciding what meals to serve and preparing the food for them.

entries.name: MEAN.JS
entries.definition: A full-stack JavaScript framework built on MongoDB, Express, Angular and Node.js.

entries.name: Meat cutting
entries.definition: Cutting and trimming carcasses and large cuts of meat into portions for sale or cooking.

entries.name: Mechanic's lien
entries.definition: A legal claim on a property that lets contractors and suppliers secure payment for work or materials they provided to it.

entries.name: Mechanical drafting
entries.definition: Producing technical drawings of mechanical parts and assemblies, by hand or with CAD software.

entries.name: Mechanical drawings
entries.definition: Technical drawings that show the shape, dimensions, tolerances and assembly of mechanical parts and machines.

entries.name: Mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems
entries.definition: The mechanical (such as heating and ventilation), electrical and plumbing systems of a building, designed and coordinated together.

entries.name: Mechanical seal
entries.definition: A device that stops fluid leaking along a rotating shaft where it passes through the casing of a pump, mixer or similar machine.

entries.name: Media buying
entries.definition: Negotiating and purchasing advertising space and airtime on media such as television, radio, print and digital channels.

entries.name: Media ethics
entries.definition: The principles of ethical conduct in journalism, broadcasting, advertising and other media work.

entries.name: Media production
entries.definition: Planning and making audio, video and other media content, from the first idea to the finished product.

entries.name: Media relations
entries.definition: Building and keeping relationships with journalists and news outlets to win press coverage for an organisation.

entries.name: Media Transfer Protocol
entries.definition: A protocol, extending the Picture Transfer Protocol, for moving media files such as music and video between a computer and a portable device.

entries.name: MediatR
entries.definition: A .NET library that implements the mediator pattern, passing requests, commands, queries and notifications to in-process handlers.

entries.name: Medical billing and coding
entries.definition: Turning healthcare services into standard codes and preparing the claims and bills sent to insurers and patients.

entries.name: Medical device development
entries.definition: Designing, testing and bringing to market medical devices under regulatory controls.

entries.name: Medical device sales
entries.definition: Selling medical devices to hospitals, clinics and clinicians, which calls for knowledge of the products and how they are used in care.

entries.name: Medical devices
entries.definition: Instruments, apparatus and software intended to diagnose, treat or monitor patients, and the rules that govern them.

entries.name: Medical equipment
entries.definition: The machines and devices used in healthcare to diagnose, treat or monitor patients.

entries.name: Medical office skills
entries.definition: The administrative and clerical skills used to run a medical office, such as scheduling patients, handling records and billing.
